scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional result is established by a group-theoretic proof. An exhaustive checker covers binary matrices only through dimension four and explicitly tests higher-dimensional witnesses; checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to simple finite-dimensional evolution algebras over the exact base field F_2, ordinary rational-point automorphisms; not a classification of maximizing isomorphism types, not geometric group schemes or extensions of the field.
title: Sharp parity-dependent automorphism maxima for simple evolution algebras over \(\mathbb F_2\)
